Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestBritishCutoverChronology_test_minus_Period_ISO.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestBritishCutoverChronology/TestBritishCutoverChronology_test_minus_Period_ISO.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The test only exercises `test_minus_Period_ISO()`; all the `data_*` methods are dead code never referenced by any test, and the vast majority of imports are unused. Let me write a clean, focused version.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). I improved understandability by removing the ~120 lines of unused `data_*` provider methods and ~50 unused imports that were dead code, keeping only the single `test_minus_Period_ISO` test with named local variables and a clarifying Javadoc explaining why subtracting an ISO period must fail. Runtime behavior is unchanged: the same `BritishCutoverDate.of(2014, 5, 26).minus(Period.ofMonths(2))` call still asserts a `DateTimeException`.
